data.title: 雪夜竹影汤池的雾气靠肩
data.location: 积雪竹林环绕的私人露天石砌温泉

data.animaCaption: Resting her forearms on the wet dark stone rim as her damp pale-pink robe slips off one shoulder, she reaches through the curling steam to brush snow from your cheek. Warm orange lantern light gleams on the water droplets across her flushed collarbone while cold snowflakes drift down behind the bamboo.
data.promptProse: Shot close across the steaming surface of a secluded stone hot spring at night, Ayachi Nene leans lightly against the damp mossy pool edge with her silver hair pinned up in a loose messy twist, stray damp locks clinging to her neck. A steam-softened pale-pink bath yukata drapes loosely across her chest and slips down one bare shoulder, glistening with fine water droplets. She raises one warm hand gently toward the viewer with a soft, flushed smile as amber light from a low stone lantern cuts through rising mist against snow-dusted bamboo in the crisp blue winter dark.
data.story: 细雪落进冒着白雾的暖汤里瞬间化开。宁宁把发丝松松挽在脑后，靠在温热的青石池边，沾满水珠的指尖轻触你微凉的侧脸，呼出的热气混进漫天雾气里——「泡久了脸好烫……不过，你靠过来一点好像更暖和。」
